description: The 'jobs_and_scenarios' dataset provides a comprehensive overview of various job scenarios, capturing essential details such as project identifiers, start times, and user information. This dataset is particularly useful for analyzing job execution patterns, monitoring performance, and identifying potential issues through error and warning counts. Each entry in the dataset includes a unique project key, the start time of the task, and the duration in seconds, allowing for precise tracking of job execution. Additionally, the dataset records the age of the job in days, any errors encountered, and the number of warnings generated, which are crucial for debugging and improving job reliability. The inclusion of user information and scenario identifiers further enhances the dataset's utility by enabling user-specific analysis and scenario tracking. This dataset is ideal for IT departments, data analysts, and project managers who need to monitor and optimize job performance and troubleshoot issues effectively.
shortDesc: Dataset of job scenarios with timestamps and user details.

columns.name: projectKey
columns.comment: Identifier for the project; key for project events.

columns.name: start_time
columns.comment: Timestamp when the task started; event timing.

columns.name: duration_seconds
columns.comment: Duration of the task in seconds; task length.

columns.name: age_days
columns.comment: Age of the event in days; event recency.

columns.name: error
columns.comment: Indicates if an error occurred; error status.

columns.name: warnings_count
columns.comment: Number of warnings generated during the job; warning tally.

columns.name: scenario_id
columns.comment: Unique identifier for the scenario; scenario key.

columns.name: user
columns.comment: User who initiated the task; task initiator.

columns.name: event_type
columns.comment: Type of event, e.g., job run; event category.
